name: Tower Crane
summary: A building-site 404 page: a swinging tower crane lifts page containers onto a half-built office block
about: A full not-found page set on a busy building site, with a site notice board, a tower crane whose load swings on real pendulum physics and a rack of containers, one for each finished page. The missing page is a dashed Floor 404 that was never on the plans. Lift containers onto the block to build working floors, then top it out with a flag and confetti.
how: The skyline rises, the crane climbs into view and swings its jib out, then tries the 404 plate in the gap
Type a page name in Find a floor and press Lift it, or click any container in the yard
The crane drives over, hooks the container, waits for the swing to settle and sets it down as a new floor
Every floor on the block is a real link; the notice board shows the page you just built
Drive the crane yourself with the arrow keys or the on-screen pad, and press Grab or Release
Build all eight floors to top out with a flag, a tree and confetti; Clear the site starts again
